Alex: Morning async — quick round: what I did / blockers / today. Drop yours below 👇

Marta: D: finished model pruning experiment for the small-LM family. B: seeing noisy regressions on long prompts, opened ticket #3421 with logs. T: will run extended eval + ask research for comparison. cc @Zach

Zach: D: merged a small fix for the batching logic (PR #789). B: need a quick review on the perf microbenchmark — pinging @Marta and @Kyra. T: finish perf tests then review outstanding PRs.

Kyra: D: rotated TLS certs for staging and validated endpoints. B: staging autoscaler is flapping after the last deploy (incident 2026-03-15-1) — collecting metrics. T: working with eng-infra to stabilize scale policies.

Ben: D: updated Dedicated rollout docs and the quickstart notebook. B: UX copy for the billing note needs a tweak; can someone from design eyeball it? T: sync with design at 3pm PT.

Alex: Quick ping — @Zach can you take Marta's perf PR? it's blocking her eval.

Zach: On it, should be a 30m review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12.3 to staging succeeded — build 4021 — logs: https://ci/redwood/4021 :rocket:

Marta: Thanks @Zach! also can someone double-check the KV cache logic in session replay? snippet: `if (kv.size() > max) kv.evict_oldest()` — wondering if eviction is LRU or FIFO here.

Kyra: FYI: we have a maintenance window tonight 21:00 UTC for infra upgrades. Expect short blips (5-10m). :warning: Plan accordingly for long-running evals.

Marta: Noted — I'll reschedule the extended eval to avoid the window.

Alex: Any blockers for the all-hands demo tomorrow? @Ben?

Ben: Slide deck is ready, but we need a stable endpoint for a short live perf run. Can eng-sre confirm an endpoint we can rely on for ~2 minutes?

Ops-Bot: Scheduled demo perf run at 09:30 UTC tomorrow and sent calendar invite to the all-hands list.

Alex: Great — appreciate the updates. If anything else pops up, drop it here. :smile:
